# Pyramid 2.9.164 exact Coral regression

The retained 2.9.163 Request 2 stopped after the first pending MATCH: 5S at
original one-based `7|1` and 8S at `7|3`. The final image is consistent with their
removal. Delivery acknowledgements and this calibration do not establish guest
credit or a successful live controller run.

`coral-effect.png`, `before-match.png` and `deal.json` are byte-original copies
from the preserved failure packet. `calibration.json` records their hashes and
provenance. The before image contains flying cards; it is not a fresh static
board or the final failed observation.

`underwater-coral-clearance-exact.rgb` contains every RGB channel of the native
144 by 34 clearance at `(286,588)`: 4,896 pixels and 14,688 bytes. Its SHA-256 is
`11058b3d28f0635ce6c546e56ac23f35abdc7358e13c7889df1078d95cacee1e`.
The full PNG SHA-256 is
`176c24ba1aeec1bb0ca2e5e9492cb3c50f57079ca56508bbee978143401b8377`.

Exactly ten blue bytes are one lower than the 159 calibration. The resulting
blue sum is 490,994, ten below the existing structural minimum of 491,004.
The cause of that rendering difference remains unproven. This additional proof
requires exact equality of the complete crop at `7|1`; it adds no tolerance,
masked region, new structural reference or reduced sum threshold. The 159-162
structural limits and the exact `7|6` rock proof remain unchanged. Strong-white
presence still takes precedence over all calibrated absence proofs.

The full-position regression requires original slots 21 and 23 absent, every
other original identity intact (including 5H at `7|6`), DL 8C and DR empty.
Negative regressions cover near matches, partial ten-pixel changes, real card
material, geometry, relocation, unsupported scenes and wrong cards or piles.
Passing the retained calibration frame does not prove coverage of future Coral
appearances. Fresh live testing remains necessary.
